name: Swarna Roy
title: Cloud & Data Engineer
summary: Building scalable cloud-native data platforms, modernizing enterprise data ecosystems through workflow orchestration, automation, and Google Cloud technologies, enabling reliable analytics and data-driven decision making at scale.
about: Cloud and Data Engineer with 2+ years of experience designing, developing, and optimizing scalable cloud-native data pipelines. Experienced in ETL/ELT development, Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer), Talend, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and cloud-native data modernization initiatives. Passionate about building reliable, scalable, and automated data solutions that enable enterprise analytics and business decision making.

description: Developed, tested, and maintained scalable cloud-native data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Designed and enhanced Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer) DAGs for ETL/ELT workflow orchestration.
Built automated data ingestion and transformation workflows using BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions.
Migrated legacy Talend-based data integration processes to cloud-native GCP solutions.
Implemented monitoring, error handling, and performance optimization techniques to improve pipeline reliability.

projects.title: SFTP to GCS File Ingestion Pipeline
projects.tech: Python, Apache Airflow, SFTP, Google Cloud Storage, SQL
projects.description: Developed a configuration-driven ETL pipeline to extract CSV files from an external SFTP system, identify files using configurable patterns, stage them in a temporary directory, and upload them to Google Cloud Storage using Airflow connection IDs.

projects.title: GCS to BigQuery Data Pipeline
projects.tech: Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Python, SQL
projects.description: Built a batch data ingestion pipeline to load files from Google Cloud Storage into BigQuery, with schema handling, data validation, transformation, and SQL-based processing for analytics.

projects.title: REST API to BigQuery Pipeline
projects.tech: Python, REST API, BigQuery, Cloud Storage
projects.description: Developed an API-based data ingestion workflow to extract JSON data from external systems, process and validate the response, stage data in Cloud Storage, and load it into BigQuery for analytics.

projects.title: Real-Time Analytics Pipeline
projects.description: Designed a real-time data pipeline to ingest event-driven data through Pub/Sub, process and transform streaming data using Dataflow, and load the results into BigQuery for near real-time analytics.

projects.title: BigQuery to Bigtable Data Pipeline
projects.description: Implemented a data integration flow to transform analytical data from BigQuery and load application-oriented records into Bigtable for high-performance, low-latency data access.

projects.title: Airflow ETL Orchestration
projects.description: Designed Airflow DAGs to orchestrate data ingestion and transformation workflows with task dependencies, scheduling, retries, error handling, and monitoring.
